selected.name: Shattered
selected.description: Four of the sixteen cut patterns push the bands as far sideways as the style goes. Kept on their own, the silhouette stops being readable as one shape, which is the far end of what the style is for.

selected.name: Pastel Wall
selected.summary: Five soft backgrounds, the drawing untouched.
selected.description: Changes nothing about the people, only what they stand in front of. The lightest way to make a set of avatars feel like it belongs together.
